question:
Fill in the blank with the correctly spelt word.

His_____ behavior during negotiations frustrated his teammates.
solution:
The correct answer is** option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The correctly spelt word is 'intransigent'.**

__
 
• The word '**intransigent**' is an **adjective** which means 'unwilling or refusing to change one's views or to agree about something'. **(हठी या कट्टर)**

 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• His **intransigent** behavior during negotiations frustrated his teammates.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'intransigent'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand some synonyms and antonyms of the word 'intransigent' - **

 
• **Obdurate (Synonym) -** stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or course of action **(ज़िद्दी)**
 
• **Uncompromising (Synonym) - **showing an unwillingness to make concessions to others, especially by changing one's ways or opinions **(समझौता न करने वाला)**
 
• **Flexible (Antonym) -** ready and able to change so as to adapt to different circumstances **(लचीला)**
